messages:
emma (support): Hey team, NovaHealth just pinged — they were charged twice for their annual renewal after attaching a PO. They have INV-2025-089 and INV-2025-089-2 on their portal. Customer says PO was applied and then a card charge also went through. Can someone triage?

mike (billing): On it. Quick Q: did they create the PO before the renewal window or after?

emma (support): PO uploaded yesterday at 15:02 UTC, renewal processed this morning 08:12 UTC. Customer says they selected 'pay via PO' in UI.

sarah (revenue ops): I see two payment records for that account in Stripe: one via our invoices connector (id pay_3Kxy...) and one card payment (id ch_1Lfz...). Looks like webhook delivered twice and created a second settlement.

finance-bot: Automated alert — duplicate settlement detected for acct: novahealth-prod. Suggested action: freeze refunds queue, flag invoices for reversal.

julian (eng): Can you paste the webhook payloads? We should check idempotency keys and webhook-retry headers. If our connector retried and connector created a second settlement without idempotency, that'd explain it.

emma (support): Pasting minimal logs from customer portal: ```POST /api/payments/webhook 200 OK
X-Retry-Reason: network_error
Idempotency-Key: null
payload: {"invoice_id":"INV-2025-089","method":"po"} ```

mike (billing): ugh — idempotency key null. Our payment service requires idempotency for webhook-led settlements. Looks like a race: PO claim came in, then card auto-pay triggered for renewal.

sarah (revenue ops): Also note VAT/tax field on the PO was empty; finance auto-applied tax and created a corrected invoice copy which may have triggered a second charge. Twofold issue.

support-l2: Customer screenshot shows 'Renewal scheduled' then a separate 'Pay now (card)' modal auto-submitted by their SSO script. Could be customer-side automation + our webhook retry.

julian (eng): Action plan from infra: 1) mark both invoices INV-2025-089 and INV-2025-089-2 as disputed in the ledger 2) rollback auto-pay for accounts with recent PO upload within 48h pending confirmation 3) patch webhook handler to reject duplicate settlements if identical invoice_id and method already processed. I'll open a PR after triage.

mike (billing): I'll prepare a manual reversal/credit note for the card charge and issue refund. For the PO invoice we'll keep it pending until customer confirms. Which payment should be reversed? Card charge first, since PO is customer-approved.

sarah (revenue ops): Agree. I'll create credit note CN-2025-45 tied to INV-2025-089-2 and mark for immediate refund. Noting VAT on the credit note.

emma (support): Customer update drafted: "We're seeing an automated double-charge due to a race between PO upload and card auto-pay. We're issuing a refund for the card charge immediately and will confirm once completed. Apologies for the inconvenience." Want approval before sending.

mike (billing): Approved. Also include expected refund timing (3-5 business days) and that we'll reverse any tax adjustments if necessary.

finance-bot: Refund initiated: refund_r_9Abc... status: pending. Payment gateway ETA 72h.

support-l2: FYI to ops: can we add a guard to UI to disable card auto-pay for 24h after PO attachment? Prevents this loop.

julian (eng): We'll add server-side 48h guard plus webhook idempotency fix. PR #2748 will include tests. ETA for deploy: EOD tomorrow.

sarah (revenue ops): Done: CN-2025-45 created, flagged VAT adjustment. Will follow up when refund clears.

emma (support): Sending the approved message to the customer now. I'll keep this thread updated. Thanks all :heart: 

mike (billing): After refund clears, let's run a small reconciliation job to find similar accounts with PO uploads within 48h of renewals. Might catch other duplicates.

julian (eng): Good call. I'll add a one-off query to the notebook and share results here.

finance-bot: Refund completed: refund_r_9Abc... status: succeeded at 1766123618.

emma (support): Customer confirmed receipt of refund and appreciates quick response. Closing after we deploy the webhook fix.

julian (eng): PR merged and deployed to staging. Will ship to prod after smoke tests tomorrow.

sarah (revenue ops): Follow-up: reconcile job found 3 more accounts with potential double-charge patterns. Opening tickets for each.

emma (support): Thanks team — marking this resolved for NovaHealth. Will link follow-up tickets in a new thread.
